title: Voice Calendar Scheduler FSM
one_liner: A 24/7 voice-driven apartment viewing scheduling assistant using Twilio/WebRTC, an 8-step FSM, and Google Calendar integration.
what_it_is: An automated voice agent that handles inbound calls or browser connections to schedule apartment viewings. It uses a Finite State Machine to guide users through preference gathering, listing search via RAG, availability checking, and final booking on Google Calendar, powered by Faster-Whisper for speech-to-text and Piper for text-to-speech.
how_its_built: Built with Python 3.11+ using FastAPI for the backend. It integrates Twilio Media Streams for PSTN and WebRTC for browser audio. The core logic relies on a git submodule engine for FSM orchestration, LLM abstraction (Claude/Ollama), and voice processing. Apartment data is indexed in LanceDB for RAG-based search, and bookings are managed via the Google Calendar API.
how_to_apply: Clone the repository recursively to include the engine submodule. Run the setup script to create a virtual environment and install dependencies. Configure API keys for LLM, Twilio, and Google Calendar in the .env file. Start the RAG service, backend, and optional editor using the provided start script.
features: Dual-channel input via Twilio PSTN and Browser WebRTC
8-step FSM-driven conversation flow for structured scheduling
RAG-based apartment listing search using LanceDB and nomic-embed
Real-time Google Calendar availability checking and event creation
Low-latency STT with Faster-Whisper and TTS with Piper
Visual workflow editor and FSM session inspector for debugging
